- The information portal must filter content to ensure that at least 90% of the displayed materials are directly applicable to trainers.
- Users should receive notifications for new trainer-specific content within 24 hours of publication, achieving a notification success rate of ≥95%.
- The system should allow trainers to customize their information preferences, with at least 80% of users reporting satisfaction with the relevance of the content received.

Test Outline:
- Conduct user testing to evaluate the effectiveness of the content filtering mechanism in displaying relevant information.
- Analyze notification logs to ensure timely delivery of updates to trainers.

Original User Story: As a site editor, I want to post information in a trainers-only section, so that only trainers see it.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to create a dedicated trainers-only section for posting information so that only authorized trainers can access this content, ensuring that sensitive information is viewed exclusively by the intended audience and reducing unauthorized access incidents by at least 100%.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The trainers-only section must restrict access to verified trainers, achieving a user verification success rate of ≥99%.
- All posted information should be visible only to users with trainer roles, with a confirmation rate of 100% during access audits.
- The system should log all access attempts to the trainers-only section, with reports generated weekly to monitor compliance.

Test Outline:
- Conduct role-based access testing to ensure that only users with trainer roles can view the content in the trainers-only section.
- Review access logs to verify that unauthorized users are consistently denied access.
